text:
OLI Architecture is an award-winning architecture practice specializing in cultural, civic, and institutional projects around the world. Our work is grounded in open collaboration and a rigorous design process that values conceptual clarity as well as deep engagement with local construction methods, materiality, and the built environment.
We are seeking experienced Architectural Designers who are strong designers, highly motivated, and skilled in Revit, particularly in construction documentation. The position offers the opportunity to work across all phases of design, from conceptual development through detailed documentation and construction administration, on a range of civic, cultural, and commercial projects.
Candidates should have a minimum of three years of professional experience in architectural practice, with demonstrated strength in construction documentation and a passion for detailing and crafting thoughtful, custom design solutions.
The ideal candidate is a strong collaborator who works efficiently, takes initiative, and thrives in a team-based studio environment. A mature understanding of project phases and high proficiency in Revit are essential. We value fluency in learning and applying new digital tools. Experience with Rhino and other 3D modeling and visualization tools is a plus.
Send CV and a PDF portfolio of both personal and professional work no larger than 18mb to [email protected]. If collaborative work, CLEARLY INDICATE ROLE on the project. Please do not send online portfolio links.
